title: Elliptic curves with rank one and nontrivial 2-part of Tate Shafarevich groups over the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-extension of $\mathbb{Q}$
summary: Let $\mathbb{Q}_\infty$ be the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_2$-extension over $\mathbb{Q}$. For each integer $n\geq1$, let $\mathbb{Q}_n$ denote the unique subfield in $\mathbb{Q}_\infty$ such that $[\mathbb{Q}_\infty:\mathbb{Q}]=2^n$. Denote by $\mathbb{Z}_2[{\rm Gal}(\mathbb{Q}_n/\mathbb{Q})]$ the group ring of ${\rm Gal}(\mathbb{Q}_\infty/\mathbb{Q})$. For any elliptic curve defined over $\mathbb{Q}$ with odd conductor, the Mazur-Tate modular element associated with the curve is an element of $\mathbb{Z}_2[{\rm Gal}(\mathbb{Q}_n/\mathbb{Q})]$.
